items.subject: mRNA-3927
items.statement: Injection site reactions (redness, swelling, pain) very common and usually mild and temporary; Fatigue, headache, muscle aches common and usually resolve within 1-3 days; Fever common after dose 2 and usually resolves within 24-48 hours
items.supporting_quote:
Injection site reactions (redness, swelling, pain) — very common, usually mild and temporary
Fatigue, headache, muscle aches — common, usually resolve within 1-3 days
Fever — common after dose 2, usually resolves within 24-48 hours
